item.title: Are rounded sans-serif typefaces good for signage/wayfinding?
item.description:
Hello,

Could anyone link me to reading on the topic of rounded sans-serif typefaces being used for signage/wayfinding? I’m wondering what the pros/cons are of using a rounded typeface.

Thank you.

item.title: Hebrew typeface for gravestone / headstone design...
item.description:
Please see my earlier posting with a similar request for help in choosing an English-language typeface for gravestone / headstone design. That posting is here:

http://typophile.com/node/119579

My difficulty with selection of Hebrew typeface is a good deal greater, since the only Hebrew typeface I already own is “Adobe Hebrew”. So, it’s harder for me to easily play around with different typeface choices.

Any thoughts or suggestions, please?

Thanks!

item.title: Guidance with selecting typeface for family gravestone...
item.description:
Subject: Guidance with selecting typeface for family gravestone…

[First time poster, here. Just did comprehensive search of the forums for similar questions, and understandably found only a few on target (last one back in 2011).]

Hi all,

I appreciate any guidance you might provide on this matter — I’m trying to select a typeface for the burial headstone for a close female family member (passed away at ripe old age). I’d like the typeface to convey a sense of her strong family ties, as well as her great warmth combined with her no-nonsense/resilient approach to life.

item.title: What is the future of Type Specimens? Are they still used or is it a dying art?

item.title: Typeface Classifications ?
item.description:
Recently I came upon a typeface class called, Realist(you guys have probably heard about it). Is it the same as Grostesque, because I saw it used for typefaces such as Akzidenz and Franklin Gothic. If not, can you please tell me about some of its characteristics.

I basically know(I think) all the general classes but can someone list them and their defining characteristics.

Thanks

item.title: What is the Tillamook logo type?
item.description: I’m wondering what the typeface is for the Tillamook logo. Is it even a typeface at all? I can’t find anything that matches the a or the k. A lot of typefaces get close, but none close enough. Any ideas? Help!

item.title: Eras Error
item.description:
Does anyone know the story behind this mistake?

Adobe’s first release of ITC Eras (version 1.000) was not slanted 2° as was intended by the type designers; Adobe fixed the mistake with version 1.001.

Does anyone have any similar examples of errors from major type foundries?

item.title: Contemporary Italian Type Design
item.description: I am designing the graphic content of a small museum celebrating the Italian immigrant contribution to Australian culture. My clients want a very contemporary look. I wondered if other typophiles might be able to recommend any recent (post Novarese) type design work coming out of Italy that would be appropriate. I need display type and a type family for bigger blocks of information. Any assistance much appreciated.
